title: ficus nemoralis var. fieldingii
intro: Ficus nemoralis var. fieldingii, commonly known as the Fielding's fig, is a rare and endangered species of fig tree native to India. It is known for its unique medicinal properties, which have been used to treat various health issues, including stress, anxiety, and insomnia. The Fielding's fig is believed to have several health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-stress properties, due to its ability to promote relaxation and reduce anxiety. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as sedation, anti-hypertension, and immune system modulation.
